_doc: Episode 1 AI story sequences (owner 2026-10-24: AI clips grouped into whole story passages, not mixed in between photos/footage). Each shot = keyframe beat (SDXL, short) + motion (Wan2.2 I2V, detailed). Cochise's face is never shown (episode states no verified image exists).

A.title: The man under the oak (cold open)
shots: side view, bearded 1880s teamster walking beside two mules pulling a wagon heaped with firewood up a dirt mountain road, {LAND}
low close view of mule hooves and iron-rimmed wagon wheels rolling over stones on a dusty dirt road, dust in sunlight, oak trees
close-up of a bearded 1880s teamster in a dusty felt hat and faded blue shirt, squinting at something ahead, mules behind him
wide view across a rocky creek, a man in a white shirt and dark vest sitting against the trunk of a huge oak, far away, {LAND}
medium view, a man in white shirt and dark vest sitting still against a huge oak, hat tipped over his face as if asleep, dappled shade
side view, two women in long 1880s riding skirts and straw hats riding a bay horse and a grey horse on a dirt track past a big oak, {LAND}
the bearded teamster seen from behind walking slowly toward a man sitting motionless under a big oak, long shadows, eerie silence
close-up of a limp hand on dry oak leaves holding an old 1870s revolver, dappled sunlight, no face
close-up of two bare feet wrapped in torn white cloth strips resting on dry oak leaves at the base of a tree, dappled light
close-up of a leather cartridge belt buckled on upside down around a man's waist, brass cartridges, white shirt, no face

B.title: The Bascom Affair
shots: a column of 1861 US cavalry soldiers in blue riding single file up a rocky mountain pass, guidon flag, oak and juniper, grey rocks
an 1861 army camp of white canvas tents in a rocky mountain pass, soldiers standing guard, Apache family approaching on foot from afar
inside an 1861 army canvas tent, a young lieutenant in a blue coat pointing angrily across a camp table at a tall Apache leader seen from behind
inside a canvas army tent, soldiers with rifles stepping in to block the tent flap, an Apache leader seen from behind turning his head
inside a canvas army tent, a knife blade slicing down through the tent wall, bright daylight bursting through the cut
seen from behind, an Apache man in a calico shirt and headband running uphill away from army tents into rocky hills, soldiers chasing
Apache women and a man sitting under guard by army tents, soldiers with rifles standing over them, somber, faces in shadow
a lone Apache rider seen from afar approaching an army camp carrying a white flag on a pole, rocky mountain pass
dozens of Apache warriors on horseback lined along a high rocky ridge above a mountain pass, silhouettes against the sky

C.title: Massai's escape from the prison train
shots: night, 1886 steam locomotive with glowing headlamp and smoke pulling dark wooden passenger cars slowly up a steep wooded grade, moonlight
night, an Apache man in a dark shirt and headband crouching on the open platform between two moving train cars, wind, smoke, moonlight
night, a man leaping from a slow moving 1880s train into dark brush beside the tracks, smoke and sparks, moonlight
night, the red lights of a train fading into the distance as a man rises from the brush beside the tracks, moonlight
night, an Apache man in a headband running through dark woods, moonlight through bare branches, mist
night, a lone man walking across wide open plains under a sky full of stars, tiny figure, distant hills
dawn, a lone man on a rocky ridge looking at distant mountains glowing in the first light, seen from behind

D.title: Ringo's last days
shots: an 1880s gunman in a dark vest and hat seen from behind sitting on a ranch porch drinking from a whiskey bottle, hot afternoon, {LAND}
distant view, a deputy on horseback meeting a lone rider with two whiskey bottles in his saddlebag on a dusty road, {LAND}
an 1880s ranch house in the afternoon, two ranch hands by a corral suddenly turning toward the hills as if hearing a shot, {LAND}
next morning, a small group of 1880s men standing in a circle around a big oak tree by a creek, hats in hands, {LAND}
a man in a white shirt sitting dead still against a big oak, seen from a respectful distance, men standing around, no blood
close-up of an old 1880s rifle leaning against the bark of an oak tree, dry leaves, dappled light
close-up of two leather cartridge belts with brass cartridges lying in dry oak leaves at the base of a tree
close-up of dusty ground at the base of an oak with no boots, only bare footprints and strips of white cloth, dappled light

E.title: Curly Bill's fight in Galeyville
shots: night, a lamplit 1881 mining camp street of plank and canvas buildings with a saloon front, horses at a hitching rail, {LAND}
inside a lamplit 1881 saloon, a drunk outlaw with a curly mustache shoving another man at the bar, onlookers backing away
inside a lamplit 1881 saloon, a revolver flash in the smoke, a man staggering back against the bar, onlookers ducking
